name: storm-canonical-workflow
summary: Machine-readable canonical Storm development workflow: BMAD owns pre-publication scope, Linear owns post-publication execution, and Polytoken execution follows plan -> reviewed handoff_plan -> active saved goal -> execute -> read_goal -> storm-linear open -> mutation. Aliases delegate to canonical operations and never reimplement state transitions.

enforcement.statement: This contract is enforced at the directive/prompt and permission-classifier level plus the deterministic validators listed below. Polytoken does not provide a physical sandbox that makes plan-facet mutation impossible; the shipped plan facet exposes shell_exec, so its read-only posture is prompt- and permission-enforced. Deterministic validators prove contract conformance of transcripts and assets; only disposable Polytoken smoke sessions prove live tool behavior. Documentation and diagnostics must state this limitation explicitly and must never claim a physical sandbox.

pre_publication.rule: BMAD planning artifacts own scope and pre-publication status. The Linear issue, if it exists yet, is not authoritative.

artifacts: Linear issue carrying the story-key-anchored spec
post_publication.rule: Linear owns implementation context and execution state from In Progress to Done. Local authoring files are evidence/history, not competing authority.

authorities.phase_decides_rule: Pre-publication, sprint-status.yaml wins; post-publication, Linear wins; on disagreement the phase decides. If the phase cannot be determined, stop and ask rather than overwrite.

artifact_lifecycle.before_publication: epics.md, sprint-status.yaml, and the BMAD story file own scope/context.
artifact_lifecycle.at_publication: storm-linear publish writes the story-key-anchored spec to the Linear issue, sets Todo + ready-for-agent, then updates the sprint entry to ready-for-dev only after successful publication.
artifact_lifecycle.after_publication: Linear owns implementation context/state; local authoring files are evidence/history, not competing authority.

review_loop_max_rounds.rule: The only source for the review round cap. Directives and templates must reference this setting, never a hard-coded number. Fixes require a complete fresh review pass; non-convergence at the cap leaves the issue In Progress and is reported.

completion_commit_policy.rule: No Storm role commits without explicit operator authority. Under require-explicit, close requires a completed authorized commit: absent or denied commit authority — or authority without a completed commit — leaves the issue In Progress and is reported; no directive may auto-commit. Under allow-without-storm-commit, close may proceed without a Storm-created commit, but commit_completed still always requires prior commit_authorized.

effects: Linear issue mirror of BMAD scope

/create-story.rule: Delegates to bmad-create-story with storm overrides (grilling + publish hook); it never resolves, drafts, or publishes independently.

/to-spec.rule: Thin adapter to the publication operation inside bmad-create-story on_complete; it never publishes outside that handoff.

/to-tickets.rule: Thin post-publication adapter to storm-linear slice; operator-invoked only, never a workflow step.

/implement.rule: Delegates to bmad-dev-story; under Polytoken it always follows plan -> reviewed handoff_plan -> active goal -> execute -> read_goal -> storm-linear open -> mutation. It never opens, commits, or closes independently.

/tdd.rule: Delegates to storm-tdd at the story's pre-agreed seams.

/code-review.rule: Delegates to bmad-code-review whose on_complete runs storm-cross-review; one merged triage and one loop.

/wayfinder.rule: No storm equivalent; must not be advertised as active.

story-execute.rule: Retired independent tracker/commit/close ownership; any retained worker is bounded and parent-controlled. Must not be advertised as active.

story-plan.rule: Retired; replaced by bmad-create-story with storm overrides. Must not be advertised as active.

definitions.scoped: Story exists in epics.md and sprint-status.yaml backlog; BMAD authority.
definitions.authoring: bmad-create-story active; story resolution and context loading done.
definitions.authored: Grilling confirmed shared understanding; story file drafted; optional spec review done or declined.
definitions.published: storm-linear publish succeeded; issue carries the story-key-anchored spec at Todo + ready-for-agent.
definitions.ready_for_dev: sprint-status.yaml entry moved to ready-for-dev after successful publication.
definitions.planning: Polytoken plan facet; implementation plan recorded with write_plan. Issue remains Todo.
definitions.plan_reviewed: Plan review discipline complete; ready for handoff_plan.
definitions.goal_activated: handoff_plan approved; saved-session goal active; execute facet entered.
definitions.executing: Execute facet active; goal not yet re-verified in this session.
definitions.goal_verified: read_goal confirms the implementation goal is active.
definitions.open: storm-linear open moved the issue (or child ticket) to In Progress.
definitions.implementing: Open verified; implementation mutation, TDD seams, and red/green evidence permitted.
definitions.close_ready: Completion record commented on the issue before any state change.
definitions.reconciled: sprint-status.yaml reconciled to done under the story key (story close only).
definitions.child_done: Child ticket moved to Done; nothing reconciled; last child reports the story ready to close.
definitions.halted_pre_open: Handoff rejected/cancelled or no active goal; issue remains Todo; mutation forbidden.
definitions.halted_in_progress: Non-clean exit (review non-converged, tests failing, denied commit authority); issue remains In Progress.

transitions.note: Atomic publish failure: sprint-status.yaml is untouched and the failure is reported with exactly what should have been written.

Operator-invoked only. Self-transition: slicing never advances state and never substitutes for sprint_ready_updated — slicing from published still requires sprint_ready_updated before planning may begin.
read_goal confirms the saved implementation goal is active. If no active goal exists, halt before opening the issue.
The session re-reads the issue and confirms In Progress before any implementation mutation.
Every fix requires a complete fresh review pass: native_review_passed and cross_review_passed must both recur before close.
Explicit operator authority; the only source of commit permission.
Completion record (what shipped, verification actually run, declined findings with reasons, deferred follow-ups) is commented BEFORE any state change.
Story close only. Unreachable from child_done: a child-ticket close reconciles nothing.
The last child's session reports the story as ready to close rather than closing the parent.

guards.review_round_cap: fix_applied is allowed only while the fresh pass it triggers stays within review_loop_max_rounds: fix_count + 2 <= max_rounds. Past the cap the only valid review exit is review_halted_non_converged, which leaves the issue In Progress.
guards.commit_authorized_seen: commit_completed requires a prior commit_authorized event in the same transcript. No commit without explicit authority.
guards.close_policy: completion_commented requires completion_commit_policy == allow-without-storm-commit or a prior successful commit_completed event (which itself requires a prior commit_authorized). Under require-explicit, commit authority without a completed commit — or absent/denied authority — halts with the issue In Progress.
guards.story_target: issue_closed requires the opened target to be a story issue.
guards.child_target: child_closed requires the opened target to be a child ticket. Child sessions never mutate, close, or reconcile the parent story.

review_policy.non_convergence: leave the issue In Progress and report outstanding items
review_policy.single_triage: The generic three-lens reviewer is only an implementation detail feeding the single native-plus-cross-review triage and loop.

child_story_rules.open_ownership: The execute session that opens an issue owns closing it out.
child_story_rules.child_close: A child-ticket close reconciles nothing and never closes, mutates, or reconciles the parent story.
child_story_rules.roll_up: The last open child's session reports the story as ready to close; the parent story is closed only by its own session.

halt_conditions: rejected or cancelled handoff_plan leaves the issue Todo with no implementation mutation
absent active saved goal after handoff blocks storm-linear open
failed or unverified open blocks implementation mutation
review non-convergence at review_loop_max_rounds leaves the issue In Progress
denied or absent commit authority under require-explicit leaves the issue In Progress
non-clean exit of any kind leaves the issue In Progress and is reported explicitly
